Boundary: Hyper-V, PowerShell Direct, guest phases, credential lookup and retained coordination calls are mocked. Snapshot/export hashing, private TestDrive records and job-result validation run locally. Separate source import/input gates and the real installed Prepare WhatIf read configuration and the pinned PNG without VM calls, hold creation or Windows state changes.

Implementation.Evidence: Bounded retained directory only, not entire user profiles or automatic screenshots
Implementation.Password: Synthetic SecureString passed separately through the fixed remoting call, absent from descriptors and reports
Implementation.Reset: Explicit verified export, pinned checkpoint restore, Off verification and matching hold release
Implementation.Snapshot: Exactly six source/data files and one pinned wallpaper PNG, verified at both ends
Implementation.OwnedUserCleanup: Requires a verified nonempty export before deletion; exports again after the phase
Implementation.NativeResult: Machine lifecycle and fixture results remain separate from visual/first-logon acceptance; all host NativeAcceptancePassed flags stay false

Recovery: Every failure retains the guest and hold. Failed guest phases attempt partial export. Pre-cleanup export failure prevents user removal. Reset retry from Off requires a saved reset intent and unchanged private export. Early preparation failures without a usable descriptor/intent require controller inspection. Local job timeout is not proof remote activity has stopped.
Remaining: Already elevated registered host execution without a new UAC prompt
Actual PowerShell Direct SecureString transport, native account/profile/session APIs and exact machine lifecycle
Interactive Control, FirstLogon and Recovery desktops, collateral theme defaults, later user choice and original-default appearance
